text:
Elaine (Sales): Heads-up — Aegis Capital pilot is blocked. CTO + CFO want a call. Two blockers: 1) Customer insists on BYO KMS + HSM attestation, 2) Pricing: they want a committed discount below our standard floor. Legal procurement timeline is tight. Need ops + security on an exec bridge. @Sofia :eyes:

Michael (SE): Can repro the KMS handshake failure in our staging. Looks like their key policy is too restrictive for our service account. Short-term workaround: allow encrypt/decrypt to our role and we'll route through Dedicated.

Aniket (SRE): We can provision a Dedicated pod for the pilot (ded-42) and isolate network egress. Will need ETA on their side for the role ARN and IP allowlist. Provision time ~ 45m once we have details.

Priya (CS): Putting together an internal runbook for exec bridge and customer-facing timeline. Suggest agenda: 1) KMS attestation & policy, 2) Pricing floor & commitment options, 3) SSO/SAML config, 4) Next steps + owners.

Sofia (CISO): From security: outstanding items in questionnaire: data residency confirmation, KMS HSM attestation doc, audit log retention settings, and SOC2 scoping. Also need to confirm MFA + SSO enforcement for admin users. Please upload their signed questionnaire here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-1234

Michael (SE): Example policy snippet I asked them to try updating (they should replace the principal with their role ARN):

```yaml
KeyPolicy:
  Version: "2012-10-17"
  Statement:
    - Effect: Allow
      Principal:
        AWS: "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Aegis-Service-Role"
      Action:
        - kms:Encrypt
        - kms:Decrypt
      Resource: "*"
```

Elaine (Sales): Pricing note — they want a 6mo low-commit floor that undercuts our published tier. Finance flagged as non-standard. @Priya can you pull the last three enterprise comps for a precedent? We need a recommended alternative ASAP.

Priya (CS): On it. Quick ask: do we have leeway to offer trial credits + usage overage cap instead of lowering floor? That buys exec time without changing published floors.

Aniket (SRE): FYI deploy-bot started provisioning at 1825000300. If they accept the role change we can cut over to ded-42 and enable KV/cache isolation.

deploy-bot: Provision event — dedicated-cluster ded-42 created at 1825000300. Node pool: g4dn.xlarge x4. Network egress: disabled by default.

Sofia (CISO): We'll need the HSM attestation PDF and KMS key ARN before we greenlight BYO KMS in Prod. For Pilot we can accept a staged attestation and audit-log export.

Michael (SE): I'll schedule a quick debug call with their infra lead — can do in 30m. If we get the role ARN + sample key policy we can validate end-to-end.

Elaine (Sales): OK team — propose exec bridge at 15:00 PT + pre-bridge sync 14:30 PT. Owners: Michael (tech), Sofia (security), Aniket (ops), Priya (cs). I'll invite Aegis CTO & CFO. Anyone object? :thumbsup:

Priya (CS): +1. I'll draft runbook and share in this thread.

Sofia (CISO): +1. Will prepare list of required docs and the security talking points.

Aniket (SRE): +1. I'll have ded-42 standby and IP allowlist snippet ready.

Michael (SE): +1. I'll bring logs and the policy snippet.

Elaine (Sales): Great — thanks everyone. I'll send calendar invite and include the runbook link.
